_meta.comment: LOCKED — Phase A seed; do not regenerate. Codex chunks B/C/D/E MUST NOT modify this file.
_meta.encoding: SCALE positional struct: u8 share_domain ‖ u8 share_role ‖ u32 LE logical_index ‖ u8 x ‖ [u8;32] value
_meta.value_provenance: 32-byte share values are sourced from the §6.3.4 normative test vectors (top-level k=3 positive + nested k=2 positive). The SCALE wrapping here exercises the codec; Phase D consumes these same values when implementing Shamir.combine.

vectors.name: top_level_lit
vectors.description: TOP_LEVEL / LIT, x=1. Positive top-level vector x=1 share from §6.3.4.

vectors.name: top_level_g3
vectors.description: TOP_LEVEL / G3, x=2. Positive top-level vector x=2 share from §6.3.4.

vectors.name: top_level_g4
vectors.description: TOP_LEVEL / G4, x=3. Positive top-level vector x=3 share from §6.3.4.

vectors.name: top_level_recipient_aggregate
vectors.description: TOP_LEVEL / RECIPIENT_AGGREGATE, x=4. Aggregate value from §6.3.4 nested-recipient vector.

vectors.name: recipient_branch_first
vectors.description: RECIPIENT_BRANCH / CONDITIONAL_RECIPIENT, x=1 (first nested recipient). Nested k=2 positive vector x=1 share from §6.3.4.

vectors.name: recipient_branch_second
vectors.description: RECIPIENT_BRANCH / CONDITIONAL_RECIPIENT, x=2 (second nested recipient). Nested k=2 positive vector x=2 share from §6.3.4.

negative_vectors.name: x_zero
negative_vectors.description: x=0 must fail validation with ERR_SHAMIR_SHARE_INDEX_INVALID.

negative_vectors.name: domain_role_mismatch_top_level_conditional
negative_vectors.description: TOP_LEVEL with role CONDITIONAL_RECIPIENT must fail with ERR_SHARE_RECORD_DOMAIN_ROLE_MISMATCH.

negative_vectors.name: domain_role_mismatch_recipient_branch_g4
negative_vectors.description: RECIPIENT_BRANCH with role G4 must fail with ERR_SHARE_RECORD_DOMAIN_ROLE_MISMATCH (cross-domain substitution defense, §6.3.4).
